parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce resonance-amplified cyclic bending stress at crankshaft fillets without changing the local fillet geometry or material strength.
parsed.viable_reason: Passive modification of crankshaft mass and support stiffness is physically feasible, and the resulting modal-frequency shift can be measured by FEA to reduce resonance-driven cyclic fillet stress when the baseline mode overlaps an engine excitation frequency.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Shifting the crankshaft's structural modes through inertia and stiffness redistribution is a non-routine departure from conventional fillet-radius modification, hardening, or damage monitoring.
